description: Standardized rate series: named LEVEL series (hl.var.oo.pi = headline variable home loan; sav.max; td.12m; biz.loan.var; cash = RBA cash rate…) and SPREAD series in bps (spread.hl.var-cash = lending pass-through; spread.hl.var-sav.max = the margin; spread.hl.var-hl.fix.36m = variable vs 3yr fixed…), per institution per day. Last-known values are explicitly status:'carried-forward' with sourceDate and fill {from, through, ageDays, reason:'no-record'} (through = the next recorded date; null = the gap is open, or no record within 60 days after the window end). Between two records the last rate is carried until the next one. After an institution's last record it is carried only while RateSonar's gap ledger shows the product that holds that rate still expected but unrecorded (not withdrawn), for at most 14 days, then the series stops; medians and spreads use the same points, so a stale value never feeds them past 14 days. The RBA cash series publishes on business days only, so its carried points have no fill; it is carried at most 14 days after its last row. Spreads and medians are status:'derived' with sourceDates; they are not observations. Pass median:true for a market-median line. Unauthenticated access and free access are clamped to the last 31 days, Enthusiast to 366 (windowClamped:true in the response). Pro tiers query deeper history in windows of at most 367 inclusive dates; large multi-series median requests may require smaller windows.

median.description: Add a _median market line per slug.
